incoming.name: Pliocene
incoming.excerpt: Alligators and crocodiles died out in Europe, as the climate cooled.

outgoing.name: Family
outgoing.excerpt: An alligator is a crocodilian in the genus Alligator of the family Alligatoridae.

outgoing.name: Florida
outgoing.excerpt: According to the Everglades National Park website, the largest alligator ever recorded in Florida was 17 feet 5 inches long (5.3 meters).

outgoing.name: Pond
outgoing.excerpt: American Alligators live in freshwater environments, such as ponds, marshes, wetlands, rivers, and swamps.
